caseName: National Labor Relations Board v. Bildisco
caseNameFull: NATIONAL LABOR RELATIONS BOARD v. BILDISCO AND BILDISCO, Debtor-In-Possession

opinions.text: The motion of United Mine Workers of America, International Union, for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae is granted. The motion of International Brotherhood of Teamsters for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae is granted.
